question: “The Invisible Man” is a science fiction novel written by famous author ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Herbert George Wells**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Herbert George Wells:-**

 
 
• ​Herbert George Wells was an English writer.
 
• Prolific in many genres, he wrote more than fifty novels and dozens of short stories.
 
• His non-fiction output included works of social commentary, politics, history, popular science, satire, biography, and autobiography.
 
• Wells' science fiction novels are so well regarded that he has been called the "father of science fiction".
 
• **The science fiction novel The Invisible Man was written by famous author H. G. Wells. It was originally serialized in Pearson's Weekly in 1897, and was published as a novel the same year. **
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **William Shakespeare:-**

 
 
• **He was a famous English poet, playwright, and actor. **
 
• He is widely regarded as the greatest writer in the English language and the world's pre-eminent dramatist. He is often called England's national poet and the "Bard of Avon".
 
 
 
• **Jules Verne:-**
 
 
• **He was a French novelist, poet, and playwright best known for his adventure novels and his profound influence on the literary genre of science fiction. **
 
• His works combine scientific prediction and romantic imagination, exploring the technological and social possibilities of scientific innovations.
 
 
 
• ** Agatha Christie:-**
 
 
• **She is a famous author who wrote many mystery novels, including The Murder of Roger Ackroyd, And Then There Were None, and Murder on the Orient Express. **
 
• She is considered to be one of the greatest mystery writers of all time.
